GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_RI_YUN.description: Gain a total pool of {TotalZhaoPo} [gold]Illumination Break[/gold]. The chosen enemy receives up to {TargetCap}; distribute the remainder among other living enemies in deterministic order. Final Generation.

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_MANG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. If the previous valid card was a Skill, the final hit deals {RefractionBonus} more.

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_CAN_MANG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If Refraction gained Brilliance this turn, deal {RefractionDamage} instead. Final Generation.

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JING_HUI.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. The first hit of your next Attack deals {ZhaoPoBonus} more if its target already has Illumination Break.

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_NING_JING_HUI.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and {LightBonus} [gold]Shine[/gold]. GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_LIU_GUANG.title: Flowing Light

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_HONG.title: White Rainbow
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_HONG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If Refraction triggered twice this turn, deal {DoubleRefractionBonus} more and apply {ZhaoPoPower:diff()} [gold]Illumination Break[/gold]. Final Generation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_HONG_GUAN_RI.title: White Rainbow Pierces the Sun
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_HONG_GUAN_RI.descri: Consume up to {MaxZhaoPoConsumed} [gold]Illumination Break[/gold] from the target. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerZhaoPo} for each stack consumed. If you have at least {GuangHuiCost} [gold]Brilliance[/gold], automatically spend it to ignore up to {PierceCap} Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JING_YUE_FAN_ZHAO.title: Mirror Moon Reflection
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JING_YUE_FAN_ZHAO.descr: Three-stage Sha Zhao, one stage per use: Mirror phase gains {Block:diff()} Block; Moon phase deals {Damage:diff()} damage; Reflection (rank 6+) gains half Block and deals half damage to all enemies, plus {GuangHui} [gold]Brilliance[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_QI_GU.selectionScre: Choose an unparasitized normal card to receive Blood Qi.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_GU.selectionScr: Choose a normal card to receive Moon Phase; hosts with Blood Qi start from the Waxing Moon.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_CHI_GU.title: Blood Pool Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_CHI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]; convert each [gold]Overflow[/gold] into {OverflowBlock} Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PI_GU.title: Blood Skin Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 1: gain {EmpoweredBlock} more. Each [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] adds 2 Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_LU_GU.title: Blood Skull Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_LU_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; [gold]Devour Remains {MaxAbsorb}[/gold]: each grants 1 [gold]Blood Skull[/gold], or heals {Heal:diff()} HP at the cap.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.title: Blade-Wing Blood Bat Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.descr: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Add a same-rank [gold]Blade-Wing Blood Bat[/gold]; [gold]Devour Remains 2[/gold]: add a [gold]Blade-Wing Blood Bat Swarm[/gold] instead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YI_HAI.title: Remains
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YI_HAI.description: Gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]. Retain. Exhausts when used; unused Remains persist in your deck after combat (max 4). Cannot be parasitized.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU.title: Blade-Wing Blood Bat
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. Then apply {LiuXuePower:diff()} Bleed. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage to every hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_QUN.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits}+2 times. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. After a kill, remaining hits move to the lowest-HP enemy. Then apply {LiuXuePower:diff()} Bleed to each surviving enemy hit. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage per hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG.title: Blood Bat King
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG.description: Deal multi-hit damage. Each Remains absorbed by Blood Bat King Gu adds 2 hits; absorbing 2 enables pursuit after a kill. If the initial target had Bleed, attack once more. Each Blood Skull adds 1 damage per hit. Ethereal.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.title: Blood Fetus Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Fusion[/gold]; [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 2, [gold]Self-Devour[/gold]: implant [gold]Blood Fetus[/gold], which can [gold]Devour Parasite[/gold] and [gold]Hatches[/gold] after 3 [gold]Fetal Movement[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.selectionScr: Choose a normal card for Blood Fetus; it may devour Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG_GU.title: Blood Bat King Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG_GU.descript: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Devour Remains 2[/gold]: add a same-rank [gold]Blood Bat King[/gold]; each adds 2 hits, and 2 grants [gold]Pursuit[/gold]. Resolve [gold]Blood Skull[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_HE_JIA_GU.title: Blood River Armor Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_HE_JIA_GU.descripti: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Blood River[/gold]: below 4 Essence, gain {LowBloodGain} Essence and {LowBlock} Block; otherwise [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 2 for {HighBlock} Block, then half next turn. Each [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] adds 2 Block.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PIAO_LIU.title: Blood Drift
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PIAO_LIU.descriptio: Usable twice. Choose an enemy as the destination. The blood tide passes through every enemy, dealing {Damage:diff()} damage and consuming up to {MaxBleedConsumed} Bleed at each stop; each consumed Bleed adds {DamagePerBleed} damage. Unconsumed Bleed flows onward and gathers at the destination. Rank 6+: on arrival, apply extra Bleed based on enemies passed.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WAN_HAI_GUI_CHAO.title: Myriad Remains Return
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WAN_HAI_GUI_CHAO.descri: [gold]Devour Remains 3[/gold]. Split a {Damage:diff()} + {DamagePerRemains} per Remains damage pool among all enemies. Gain {Block:diff()} + {BlockPerRemains} Block per Remains. Rank 6+: if 3 Remains are actually consumed, gain half of this Block next turn. Materials are not returned until combat ends.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.title: Blood Moon Sacrifice
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.description: Usable 1-3 times by rank. Choose a [gold]Blood Parasite[/gold] host. Without playing it, advance the parasite once; if it reaches its final stage, [gold]Hatch[/gold] normally. Rank 9: gain 2 [gold]Blood Essence[/gold] when a hatch completes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_JI.selectionScr: Choose a card with a Blood Parasite.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.selec: Choose a Blade-Wing Blood Bat, or use Devour Remains 2 to create a Blood Bat Swarm.

sha_zhao_material.title: Sealed Material Pile
sha_zhao_material.description: Materials sealed by Sha Zhao derivation. They fly back to the Gu recovery pile and recover from zero when the Sha Zhao is used or dismantled; if the Sha Zhao is an Exhaust card, materials are still returned after use, with +1 recovery turn.
